tagline: Share Notion content in Teams and capture meeting notes back in the knowledge base
metaTitle: Notion Teams Integration: Page Updates and Meeting Notes
metaDescription: Keep Microsoft Teams in step with your Notion docs. GAIA posts Notion page updates to Teams and saves Teams meeting notes in Notion. See the setup steps.
keywords: capture Teams meeting notes to Notion
intro:
Enterprise teams that rely on Microsoft Teams for communication and Notion for knowledge management constantly lose information in the gap between the two. A document published with important policy updates never reaches most of the team because they are living in chat. Meeting decisions made in a call are never written up because someone has to manually transcribe them after the fact. The knowledge base and the conversation platform operate as separate worlds, and institutional knowledge accumulates nowhere.

GAIA connects the two so information moves between them. When an important page is published, GAIA posts a rich summary to the relevant channel. When a meeting concludes, GAIA generates structured meeting notes and saves them directly to a page linked to the meeting's agenda. Important messages can be pinned to the knowledge base with a single reaction, and pages can be referenced in chat with automatic previews.

This integration is particularly valuable for large organizations standardized on Microsoft 365 that use the knowledge base as an internal wiki, for consulting teams that document client work in Notion but coordinate in Teams, and for any enterprise team that wants to reduce knowledge loss between its communication and documentation platforms.

useCases.title: Post Notion page updates to Teams channels
useCases.description: When a page in a configured workspace or database is published or significantly updated, GAIA sends a formatted message to the relevant channel with the page title, author, a summary of changes, and a direct link for the full document.

useCases.title: Capture Teams meeting notes automatically in Notion
useCases.description: After a meeting ends, GAIA generates structured meeting notes using the meeting transcript or key messages and creates a page in a designated meeting notes database, complete with attendees, date, agenda items, decisions, and action items.

useCases.title: Save important messages to the knowledge base with a reaction
useCases.description: Team members can react to a message with a configured emoji to trigger GAIA to save it to an 'Important Messages' database, creating an accessible knowledge record from in-the-moment conversations.

useCases.title: Daily digest of new content
useCases.description: Each morning GAIA posts a structured message listing all pages created or updated in the past 24 hours, organized by workspace section, so the team starts the day knowing what is new in the knowledge base without opening the workspace separately.

useCases.title: Link channel conversations to project pages
useCases.description: GAIA can associate a Microsoft Teams channel with a Notion project page, posting a project context card to new channel members and ensuring that major project updates are always surfaced in the discussion thread.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and Microsoft Teams to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Notion workspace and Microsoft Teams organization through GAIA's integration settings. GAIA uses OAuth for both and only requests the minimum permissions needed: message send for chat and page read/write for the knowledge base.
Specify which databases trigger channel notifications, which channels are linked to which sections, how meeting notes should be formatted and filed, and which reactions should trigger saves.

howItWorks.step: GAIA bridges your wiki and your chat automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both sides for configured triggers and executes information flows in real time. Your channels stay informed about page updates, and important discussions find their way into your permanent knowledge base.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with Microsoft Teams private channels?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can be configured to post to and read from both standard and private channels, provided the GAIA bot is added to the private channel and granted appropriate permissions. Private channel content is handled securely and never routed to unintended destinations.

faqs.question: Can GAIA capture meeting notes without using the transcript feature?
faqs.answer: If transcription is not available or enabled, GAIA creates a structured meeting notes template as a page, pre-populated with attendee names, meeting title, date, and duration. A team member can then fill in key decisions and action items, and GAIA files it in the right location.

faqs.question: Is this integration compatible with Microsoft 365 GCC or government cloud environments?
faqs.answer: GAIA's chat integration is designed for standard Microsoft 365 commercial environments. Government cloud (GCC) compatibility depends on the specific API endpoints available in that environment. Contact the GAIA team for guidance on GCC deployments.
